data_per_call.statement: data-per-call limits apply to both sync and async insights calls and return error_code = 100, CodeException (error subcode: 1487534)
data_per_call.advice: limit the query by the date range or the number of ad ids, or break it into multiple queries

token_error.meaning: an expired or invalid access token (the generic Graph error table)

throttle_codes.ads_account_series: the 80000 series (80000, 80003, 80004 and 80014 are named on the rate limit page)

usage_header.estimated_time_to_regain_access: Time in minutes to regain access.

other_headers_named.X-FB-Ads-Insights-Throttle: app_id_util_pct, acc_id_util_pct and ads_api_access_tier for the Ads Insights endpoints; the relay does not read it

http_status_per_code: ASSUMED: the pages give the codes and not the HTTP status they arrive with
